external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers who review and approve or reject uploaded paperwork.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The SaaS vendor that hosts the portal and pushes supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the supplier extract and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where supplier compliance documents stay.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: The database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Suppliers sign in and upload compliance paperwork through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, contact details for supplier staff, and supplier sign-in credentials

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category managers review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it through the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The portal stores uploaded supplier documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier compliance documents and staff contact details

data_flows.name: push data extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says the nightly extract is 'encrypted end to end', while the landing bucket runbook says 'the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is'. These claims do not settle the transport encryption state.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the supplier extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the text identifies it as a portal.
assumptions.basis: The component is named 'Supplier document portal'; the extraction rules classify a portal as a web interface.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform holds confidential data because it stores compliance documents and staff contact details, which describe people or commercially sensitive records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details stay in the vendor's platform.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket holds confidential data because it receives the supplier data extract containing supplier records.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket receives a supplier data extract and that the extract is loaded as supplier records.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database holds confidential data because it contains supplier records including staff contact details and compliance information.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
